genre_target: IELTS Task 1 动态图主体段 / 论文训练动力学与收敛曲线分析段
domain_context: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写动态折线图（或模型训练收敛曲线）的主体细节段：把一条经历“初期缓慢爬升 -> 中期爆发增长 -> 后期高位平台期”的曲线，以及另一条“冲高回落”的曲线对比写活。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【IELTS Task 1 动态图主体段 / 论文训练动力学与收敛曲线分析段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写动态折线图（或模型训练收敛曲线）的主体细节段：把一条经历“初期缓慢爬升 -> 中期爆发增长 -> 后期高位平台期”的曲线，以及另一条“冲高回落”的曲线对比写活。”。请严格按照 `BP26` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L026`（生成模型三元权衡论证规范：生成质量、模式覆盖度与采样效率（Generative Trilemma Logic）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: In 2000, A was 12% and B was 54%. Then in 2005, A increased to 15%. In 2018, A increased to 48%. In 2025, A was 47%. B increased to 61% in 2004, and then decreased to 24% in 2025.
structural_constraints: S1 [起始点位对比 Initial Standing]：At the beginning of the period in [2000], [Entity A] stood at a modest [12%],less than a quarter of [Entity B]'s initial figure ([54%]).

S2 [多阶段演进：缓升转暴涨 Phased Acceleration]：After rising marginally over the firstfive years, [Entity A] surged nearly threefold between [2005] and [2018], peaking at [48%] before stabilizing on a high plateau.
S3 [反向曲线对比：冲高回落 Counter-Trajectory]：Conversely, [Entity B] climbed briefly to [61%] in [2004] but subsequently entered a prolonged decline, dropping by more than half to [24%] by [2025].
S4 [终局交叉总结 Terminal Comparison]：Consequently, the initial [42]-percentage-point gap between the two categories had completely reversed by the final year.
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）

genre_target: IELTS Task 2 (Advantages vs. Disadvantages) / 论文设计权衡（Trade-off）段
domain_context: 雅思小作文动态/静态图表与实证数据综述
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想回应 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' 题型：把弊端定性为“暂时的、可通过技术/规则收敛的局部成本”，把优势定性为“不可替代的结构性长期突破”。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 2】假设你正在撰写【IELTS Task 2 (Advantages vs. Disadvantages) / 论文设计权衡（Trade-off）段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想回应 'Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?' 题型：把弊端定性为“暂时的、可通过技术/规则收敛的局部成本”，把优势定性为“不可替代的结构性长期突破”。”。请按 `BP38` 的句子角色分工，先列出每句的主语核心词与谓语强动词，再连缀成完整段落。
source_material_or_draft: We disagree that our paper lacks novelty. Although A and B existed before, nobody used them together on time series forecasting. Also our results are very good, so our paper is novel.
structural_constraints: S1 [权衡定性主题句 Asymmetry Thesis]：Weighing both dimensions reveals that the long-term structural benefits of [X] far outweigh its manageable transitional costs.

S2 [将弊端限定为可收敛成本 Bounding the Drawback]：While [Drawback A, e.g., initial capital outlay / training overhead] poses a tangible hurdle, this cost is bounded and diminishes rapidly as [Mitigating Factor, e.g., hardware amortization / open-source standardization] matures.

S3 [凸显优势的不可替代性 Highlighting Irreversible Gain]：By contrast, the core advantage—[Benefit B, e.g., eliminating human exposure to hazardous environments / discovering non-linear scientific laws]—delivers compounding value that manual methods cannot replicate at any cost.
S4 [权衡结论 Trade-off Verdict]：Therefore, addressing the friction through targeted safeguards is far more rational than forgoing the transformative gain.

消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）

genre_target: IELTS Task 1 静态图表段 / 论文开销拆解（Breakdown）段
domain_context: 非平稳时间序列预测与分布漂移消除
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写静态柱状图或饼图的主体段：横向对比不同国家/不同模型在不同开销维度上的占比差异，灵活运用倍数（double/triple）、分数（nearly a third）与排序结构。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: In this paper, we propose a novel and groundbreaking model called DyTS-Net. It has three modules: Module A, Module B, and Module C. They work together to delve into the data and get state-of-the-art performance.
structural_constraints: S1 [主导项锁定 Dominant Category]：Regarding [Group 1], [Category A] claims the largest share at [46%], nearly double the proportion allocated to [Category B] ([24%]).
S2 [组间横向反差 Cross-Group Contrast]：A markedly different allocation pattern emerges in [Group 2], where [Category C] dominates at [52%], while [Category A] shrinks to just [15%].
S3 [次要项合并归纳 Minor Categories Grouping]：Meanwhile, the remaining categories—[Category D and E]—collectively account for less than [12%] across both groups.
S4 [结构性差异提炼 Structural Takeaway]：These figures indicate that whereas [Group 1] prioritizes [Function A], [Group 2] concentrates resources heavily on [Function C].
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）

source_material_or_draft: In 2000, A was 12% and B was 54%. Then in 2005, A increased to 15%. In 2018, A increased to 48%. In 2025, A was 47%. B increased to 61% in 2004, and then decreased to 24% in 2025.

S4 [终局交叉总结 Terminal Comparison]：Consequently, the initial [42]-percentage-point gap between the two categories had completely reversed by the final year.
